'''''Star Wars: Jango Fett''''' is a comic miniseries by [[Marvel Comics]]. The series was written by [[Ethan Sacks]], illustrated by [[Luke Ross]], with the [[Jango Fett 1|first issue]] published on [[March 20]], [[2024]].

Sacks revealed via Twitter that the series is set around [[33 BBY]],<ref name="33 BBY" /> specifically a few months<ref name="Few Months">{{Twitter|ethanjsacks|status/1803540946010906725|[[Ethan Sacks]]|quote=months. Was going to write a "few"}} {{C|In response to: ""Months" or "a month". A timeliner needs to know 🤣"}}</ref> before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="33 BBY" /> According to Sacks, more [[Jango Fett]]-focused stories will be told if the comic series is successful.<ref name="More to come">{{Twitter|ethanjsacks|status/1758920446194377159|[[Ethan Sacks]]|quote=FOC for JANGO FETT#1 is fast approaching, like an angry fathier! Pre-order your copy from your local comic store. If this series is as successful as I hope, there will be a lot more Jango on the way! Plus great art from @LukeRossArt!}}</ref>
